LanguageData.RavenResearch_MechanicalAngel.label: [Raven] Divine Husk Corruption
LanguageData.RavenResearch_MechanicalAngel.descriptio: By studying ancient mechanical angel remains and combining them with Raven bio-alchemy and aphrodisiac techniques, you can develop a "Corruption Training" process to completely rewrite the underlying protocols of transcendent mechanoids. Unlocks the Divine Husk Corruption Pod and the cultivation of the Aegis mech.
